manifest.name: You Are Wild: Simple Narrator
manifest.description: Adds concise provider-generated narration with selectable player-safe perspectives after deterministic scene exchanges.

settings.label: Provider connection
settings.description: Choose a text-generation profile managed in AI Providers. Credentials remain session-only.

settings.label: Narration profile
settings.description: Storyteller emphasizes scene and consequence. Character reactions emphasizes observable behavior and supplied dialogue. Hybrid balances both.

settings.label: Narration perspective
settings.description: Player POV is the default. Other modes change grammatical framing only; deterministic events and structured actor, target, self, and observer roles remain authoritative.

settings.label: Narration instructions
settings.description: Optional style guidance applied after the selected perspective and profile. It cannot override viewpoint roles, deterministic facts, policy, plain-text, or length constraints.
settings.default: Write concise, vivid narration focused on what the player perceives. Follow the selected narration perspective. Give dialogue room when characters speak. Avoid repeating interface labels.
